# #1660: the runtime-semantics baseline (track #1648). Every `fail` line is a
# known defect. The slice that fixes it must delete its line, because this
# marker is strict: a listed case that starts passing fails the gate.
passed=2 failed=6

# #1649 (S0): agent state with an enum or Option faults on every reload, even
# when the handler wrote only a scalar beside it.
fail a scalar Cell beside an enum Cell reads back after a reload
fail an enum Cell reads back after a reload
fail an Option Cell reads back after a reload

# #1652 (S3): `==` on records and Option is reference equality.
fail a record equals an identical record
fail Some(1) equals Some(1)

# #1650 (S1): String.replace expands `$&` in the replacement.
fail String.replace inserts its replacement literally
